name: copier-pyproject
description: Companion plugin for the hasansezertasan/copier-pyproject Copier template. Ships three skills: `adopt` (first-time adoption of the template into an existing/published Python package), `update` (pulling later template changes via `copier update` and reviewing Renovate copier-update PRs), and `setup` (one-time repository + release-automation wiring — trusted publishing, branch protection, secrets, App installs).
